r1c2/r2c1/r2c3, mouth interiors and jawline: open-mouth shapes feel like generic swapped symbols, with inconsistent teeth, tongue and cheek deformation rather than one premium rig.

top_fix: Rebuild the facial deformation rig around locked REF proportions and coherent 3D facial volumes, prioritizing consistent eyes/brows and anatomically connected mouth-cheek-jaw shapes across concern, blinking, open vowels and head turns.
